title: The Final Battle
description: The decisive engagement at Gravenmark. Every military decision you have made converges here. The outcome determines whether Veltria exists as a sovereign nation.

title: Budget Allocation — Final War Budget
description: The decisive engagement will consume resources at an accelerated rate. Whatever the outcome, the treasury must be positioned to handle victory, stalemate, or defeat. Each requires a different fiscal posture.

title: International Forum — The Showdown
description: The Forum's emergency session has become a diplomatic confrontation. Every ambassador wants to be on the record. Every power wants to shape the outcome. The question is whether you control the narrative or the narrative controls your options.

title: International Response — Coordination
description: The superpowers are coordinating — which is unusual enough to be alarming. Arcturian and Orythian diplomats in the same room, drafting the same statement. The question is who they're coordinating against.

title: Tomas — The Last Conversation
description: Tomas asked to meet you. Not at the residence — at the park where you used to take him when he was small. He's wearing the sweater you gave him two years ago. It almost still fits. He has something to say that he's been rehearsing.
